open_mathematics: For negative x valuation the equality boundary is complete. In the remaining strict cone start with the generic g=m w ray over Q(i)(m), compute its unit pivot divisor, then treat the rays g=m w^2 and w=m g^2 or refine according to the generic exponents. The m=1 probes on the three rays are certified. At (w,g)=(t^2,t) the only mismatch with the balanced diagonal is three 0-to-1 indices in the character-one quartic center despite identical maximal losses. At (t,t^2) four of the sixteen uncut length-four matrices already disagree with the proposed edge sum. Check the center frame before passing to the four cuts. Arbitrary unit residue levels at xbar=-1 beyond degree four (genus-97 cover), other general units, and unrestricted nonsymmetric branches remain open.
